data.name: Poisonous
data.description: Vine leshys made from poison ivy vines carry natural poison in their bodies. As a swift action, the leshy can imbue its vines with this irritating substance. The next time the leshy hits a creature with an unarmed strike, the creature is affected by the following poison.&nl;Vine Leshy Toxin: Unarmed strike--injury; save Fort DC %1; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect sickened for 1 round; cure 1 save.&nl;The leshy can use this ability %2 times per day. A vine leshy is immune to its own poison, but not to those of other vine leshys.&nl;This replaces plantspeech and change shape.|VineLeshy_ToxinDC|VineLeshy_ToxinTimes
